name: Big Rapids Farmers' Market
tagline: Friday farmers market – The Ferris State Torch
description: Big Rapids Farmers' Market gathers local farms and food producers in 310 North 4th Ave Big Rapids, MI. The market is a hub for seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from nearby growers. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
